name: sugya
description: Learn Torah, Talmud and halakhah with an AI that answers only from the classical library on sugya.org, with an exact reference and a link on every claim: daf yomi, chavruta, finding a source, marei mekomot, the Jewish calendar.

interface.shortDescription: Torah, Talmud and halakhah from the classical library, with exact references
interface.longDescription: sugya gives the assistant the classical Torah library — Tanakh, Mishnah, Talmud and its commentaries, Midrash, Rambam, Shulchan Arukh with Mishnah Berurah, Responsa, Musar — through search, reading, a link graph, a dictionary and the Jewish calendar. Every answer cites the text it read, with a link to sugya.org. It shows where the sources are; it does not rule: for practical halakhah, ask a rav.
defaultPrompt: Learn today's daf yomi with me.
Where does the phrase «דעלך סני לחברך לא תעביד» come from?
What are the sources on washing hands in the morning?
